Time taken by B alone = 45/1 = 45 days

Tap A can fill a tank in 20 hours and another tap B can empty two-fifth of the tank in 6 hours. Both the taps are opened together for 20 hours, then in how many hours the remaining tank can be emptied by Tap B alone if tank was completely filled initially?
questions.solution_en:
A = 20 hours

B = (5*6)/2 = 15 hours

Total capacity of tank = LCM of 20 and 15 = 60 units

Efficiency of Tap A = 60/20 = 3 units/hour

Efficiency of Tap B = 60/15 = - 4 units/hour (discharge tap)

Efficiency of A and B together = 3 - 4 = - 1 unit/hour

Tank emptied in 20 hours by A and B together = 20*1 = 20 units

Units left = 60 - 20 = 40

40 units get emptied by tap B alone

Units left/efficiency of B = 40/4 = 10 hours

questions.q_en: Kiran sold a copper jug to Sohil at 21% profit and Sohil sold it to Zinat at (100/11)% of profit and Zinat again sold it to Varsha at (100/3)% of profit. If Varsha purchased the copper jug at Rs. 2970, then at what price Kiran purchased the copper jug.
questions.solution_en:
Let the cost price of copper jug for Kiran = Rs. 100x

Cost price of copper jug for Sohil = Rs. 100x * 121/100 = Rs. 121x

Cost price of copper jug for Zinat = Rs. 121x * 12/11 = Rs. 132x

Cost price of copper jug for Varsha = Rs. 132x * 4/3 = Rs. 176x

=> 2970 = 176x

=> x = 2970/176 = 16.875

So, Kiran purchased the copper jug = Rs. 100 * 16.875 = Rs. 1687.5

questions.q_en: The ratio of the speed of a boat downstream to the speed of a stream is 4: 1. If a boat covered 352 km against the current in 22 hours, then find the speed of a boat in still water.
questions.solution_en:
Speed of a boat in still water = downstream speed of a boat - speed of a stream

= (4x - x) km/hr

= 3x km/hr

Upstream speed of a boat = speed of a boat in still water - speed of a stream

= (3x - x) km/hr

= 2x km/hr

Speed = Distance /Time

Speed of a boat upstream = 352/22

2x = 16

x = 8

The speed of a boat in still water = 3 * 8 = 24 km/hr

A can finish a job in 16 days and B can do it in 24 days. They start together. After 4 days A's efficiency increases by 40% and B's efficiency by 20%. How many more days it will take to finish the remaining job?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 16 and 24 = 48 units

Efficiency of A = 48/16 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of B = 48/24 = 2 units/day

Work done in 4 days = (3 + 2) X 4 = 20 units

New efficiency of A = 3 X 1.4 = 4.2 units/day

New efficiency of B = 2 X 1.2 = 2.4 units/day

Remaining work = 48 - 20 = 28 units

Time taken to complete remaining work = 28/(4.2 + 2.4) = 28/6.6 = 4(8/33) days

questions.q_en: A right pyramid stands on a square base of diagonal 24√2 cm. If the height of the pyramid is 24 cm, find the area of its slant surface.
questions.solution_en:
Slant height = √[(Diagonal/2)2 + height2]

= √[(24√2/2)2 + 242]

= 12√6cm

Side of square = diagonal/√2 = 24√2/√2 = 24 cm

The area of a slant surface = 1/2 * (Perimeter of base) * Slant Height

= 1/2 * (4 * 24) * 12√6

= 576√6 cm2

questions.q_en: Pipe A can fill a tank in 60 hours and Pipe B can fill half of the tank in 45 hours. Find the time taken by Pipe A and Pipe B together to fill the tank.
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Pipe B to completely fill the tank = 45 * 2 = 90 hours

Total capacity of the tank = LCM of 60 and 90 = 180 units

Efficiency = Total capacity/ Time taken

Efficiency of pipe A = 180/60 = 3 units

Efficiency of Pipe B = 180/90 = 2 units

Time taken by Pipe A and Pipe B to fill the tank = 180/ (3 + 2) = 36 hours
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: A boat goes 48 km upstream and 56 km downstream in 12 hours. It goes 60 km upstream and 42 km downstream in 13 hours. Find the speed of boat in still water and speed of current (in kmph)?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of boat in still water be a and speed of current be b.

Speed of upstream = a - b

Speed of downstream = a + b

Therefore, 48/(a-b) + 56/(a+b) = 12

60/(a-b) + 42/(a+b) = 13

Take x = 1/a+b and y = 1/a-b

On solving, we get x = 1/14 and y = 1/6

We get a = 10 kmph and b = 4 kmph

questions.q_en: If a² + b² + c² = 2(a + c - 1), then the value of a3 + b3 + c3 = ?
questions.solution_en:
a3 + b3 + c3 = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ca) + 3abc

We are given: a2 + b2 + c2 = 2(a + c - 1)

=> a2 + b2 + c2 = 2a + 2c - 2

Rearrange the given equation:

a² + b² + c² - 2a - 2c + 2 = 0

Complete the squares:

(a² - 2a + 1) + b² + (c² - 2c + 1) = 0

(a - 1)² + b² + (c - 1)² = 0

For the sum of squares to be zero, each individual square term must be zero.

Therefore:

(a - 1)² = 0 => a = 1

b² = 0 => b = 0

(c - 1)² = 0 => c = 1

Calculate a≥ + b≥ + c≥:

a3 + b3 + c3 = 13 + 03 + 13 = 1 + 0 + 1 = 2
